annotation.title_clean: Communiqué of the Regional Conference on the Peace and Security Aspects of Autonomous Weapons Systems: An ECOWAS Perspective
annotation.title_en: Communiqué of the Regional Conference on the Peace and Security Aspects of Autonomous Weapons Systems: An ECOWAS Perspective
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ECOWAS Member States (Regional Conference, Freetown, Sierra Leone)
named_instruments_referenced: UNGA Resolution on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Systems 2023
annotation.summary_en: Communiqué from ECOWAS Member States at the April 2024 Freetown conference on autonomous weapons systems. It expresses concern about AWS proliferation, use by non-state actors and the loss of meaningful human control. The states commit to supporting urgent negotiation of a legally binding instrument with prohibitions and regulations, and to developing a common regional position.
key_provisions_or_claims: Commit to support urgent negotiation of a legally binding instrument with prohibitions and regulations on autonomous weapons systems
Emphasise meaningful human control as critical to upholding ethical, legal and humanitarian obligations
Warn of AWS proliferation to terrorists, criminal networks and non-state armed groups, and of arms-race risks
Endorse work towards a common ECOWAS regional position on AWS
Reference the 2023 UNGA resolution, the Belén Communiqué, the CARICOM Declaration and ACHPR Resolution 473
